caption: The worked example's path to failure: 25.0% of the 120 requirements changed and 2 of 8 developers left, so the only tester got a 2-month testing window starting in month 5. Testing late with a large untested build is the early warning to catch.

spec.title: Worked example: 6-month project, 8 developers, 1 tester, 120 requirements
spec.aria: A chain runs from 30 of 120 requirements changing and 2 of 8 developers leaving, through a fixed 6-month deadline and rising defects, to a 2-month testing window starting in month 5, ending in project failure.
